drmTMB::phylo(term, tree) and drmTMB::animal(term, pedigree) markers. Internally uses Hadfield & Nakagawa (2010) A-inverse sparse-precision (all-nodes: latent vector spans tips + internal nodes). Extractor sets metadata$phylo_representation = "all_nodes".

Phylogenetic meta-analysis via rma.mv(..., R = list(species = A)) where A is the k x k tips-only phylogenetic correlation matrix (Sigma_species = sigma^2_p * A, with sigma^2_p estimated). Distinct from V = V (fixed sampling covariance). Extractor discriminates phylo vs spatial vs generic by R-matrix group name.

Phylogenetic random effect via gr(species, cov = A) inside (1 | gr(species, cov = A)) terms. A is the k x k tips-only phylogenetic correlation matrix. Extractor sets metadata$phylo_representation = "tips_only".

Phylogenetic random effect detected via fit$ginverse (the Hadfield-Nakagawa all-nodes A-inverse sparse-precision path). Same code path serves both phylogenetic comparative method use and animal-model quantitative-genetics use -- same A matrix, different source (tree vs pedigree). Extractor sets metadata$phylo_representation = "all_nodes".

Phylogenetic random effect detected via propto(0 + group | g, A) blocks (blockCode 11). Full conditional covariance is sigma_p^2 * A + sigma_res^2 * I (two free scalars). Extractor sets metadata$phylo_representation = "tips_only" + emits the propto_two_scalars info row in warnings_registry.

Phylogenetic GLS via phylolm::phylolm() with Gaussian outcome and identity link. PGLS marginal form: y = X*beta + e, e ~ N(0, sigma^2 * C(alpha)) where C(alpha) is a tree-derived correlation matrix. BM and Pagel's lambda first-slice; OU / EB / kappa / delta / trend deferred.

Phylogenetic correlation is the residual structure -- no separate u_p random effect; phylolm marginalizes u_p into e. Extractor sets metadata$phylo_representation = "pgls_marginal" and records the evolutionary model in metadata$phylo_model.
